name: ladder
title: Ladder
summary: A climbable ladder line (LADDER GE) up a wall, with an optional mesh. Pivot: the floor at the foot of the wall; the climber stands on the +X side (place it with wall:"nearest").

offset.summary: Distance of the climb line from the wall

mesh.summary: A ladder static mesh to show (none by default: ladder meshes come with map packages)
